messages:
marta: Heads-up — customer (tenant acme-inc) hit repeated 410s on /v1/rerank. They're sending model_id `rerank-legacy-2022` which we removed last week. Need quick mitigation, they're blocking prod.:grimacing:

ops-bot: [automated] model-deprecation notice: rerank-legacy-2022 removed 2025-11-05T14:03:00Z (deprecation policy expired)

samir: can you paste the exact request/response and SDK version? also: do they use an internal cache for model ids?

marta: here’s the curl / payload they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{\n    "model": "rerank-legacy-2022",\n    "input": ["Which widget is best?", "doc:1", "doc:2"]\n  }'
```
and the API responded with:
```
HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model rerank-legacy-2022 is deprecated and removed; use rerank-v2 or alias rerank/latest",
    "code": 410,
    "detail": "legacy model removed for security/quant updates",
    "suggested_model": "rerank-v2"
  }
}
```

leo: looks like their runtime is shipping the raw model id into our client lib (no alias resolution). they hit the grace-period end and got a hard 410. @samir did we intentionally disable alias redirects?

samir: we had a 7-day redirect window after deprecation. it expired yesterday as part of policy. we can manually re-enable per-tenant redirects for a short window (48h) while customers migrate. i'll open an infra ticket and add a temporary suggestion header.

marta: customer asks for concrete repro + workaround. proposed steps i gave them:
- Update calls to use alias `rerank/latest` or explicit `rerank-v2`
- If you have a model-id cache, clear it and restart the service
- If immediate unblock needed, request a temporary redirect from Redwood support (we can enable per-tenant)

samir: created infra ticket I-4852 to re-enable redirect for tenant `acme-inc` and to add response header `X-Rerank-Suggest: rerank-v2`. ETA ~2h. also adding a small SDK patch to prefer aliases by default.

ops-bot: Acknowledged. Running per-tenant redirect toggle for acme-inc... done. Redirect active until 1987655521. :white_check_mark:

marta: confirmed with customer — after redirect they retried and got 200 OK, non-zero scores. they will patch their service to use the alias. they asked for a short note to share with their infra team.

samir: follow-ups: (1) add clearer error message recommending alias when model id removed (2) add monitoring / alert for deprecated-model API usage so support can proactively reach out. will follow up on I-4852 and SDK patch.

leo: nice, please add a KB note in #support-docs with the repro and migration checklist.

marta: will draft KB and ping you both. closing once KB is up and customer confirms SDK upgrade. :party_popper:
